v05-restaurant-massana.why: ★ since 2007; chef Pere Massana — the city's reliable counterpoint to the Rocas. To order: the truffle dishes in season; the à-la-carte classics; the tasting menu. A walkable one-star inside Girona if Can Roca is booked out.
